title: Independent reading: 1 John 1:1–10
subtitle: Trace witness, fellowship, condition, and contrast.
overview: 1 John 1 moves from witness testimony into a chain of conditional claims about fellowship, light, truth, and confession. Mark the shift from proclamation to direct communal address.
Repeated ἐὰν clauses and contrastive particles organize the paragraph; read them as connected claims rather than independent maxims.

items.grc: ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία.
items.en: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

items.grc: ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, πιστός ἐστιν καὶ δίκαιος.
items.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous.
